title: Quadcopter
description: FPV drone: carbon plates and arms, motors, props, battery. The props have to clear each other.

params.name: arm_count
params.label: Arms
params.help: 4 is a quad, 6 a hexacopter. Props spin in opposite pairs, so it's always even.

params.name: arm_length
params.label: Arm length
params.help: Centre to motor. Longer arms make room for bigger props.

params.name: prop_diameter
params.label: Prop diameter
params.help: Bigger props lift more, but they have to clear their neighbours.

params.name: motor_size
params.label: Motor diameter
params.help: Bigger motors push harder and weigh more.

params.name: plate_size
params.label: Plate size
params.help: The square carbon plates in the middle.

params.name: battery_mah
params.label: Battery
params.help: Capacity: longer hover time, but a heavier drone.
